integrity: All analytical assertions are supplied with the explicit Hankel matrix, Poisson-variance identity, discriminant calculation and asymptotics. Supplementary finite checks do not certify infinite-parameter statements.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns two-term Hardy symbols of the form z+t z^m, m>=2, real t>0; beyond the threshold it does not classify all local kernel maxima. The finite checker is supportive only. No independent scientific or publication-priority audit was performed.
title: An exponential localization threshold for Garsia-norm testing of sparse Hardy Hankel symbols
